verdict.rationale: Pulley documents that the cap table can be downloaded as an Excel file, either as of a specific date or for all time. That is its own export capability for the core ownership data. Nothing shows a full account export covering documents, signed agreements, stakeholder profiles, valuations or transaction history, and no API was found to support programmatic exit. Missing for 10: full-account data export beyond the cap table, export of uploaded/signed documents, explicitly open or machine-readable formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), a documented offboarding or data-portability process, and independent corroboration.
